title: Share Your Faith
description: Practical tools for sharing discipleship naturally in everyday life.

cards.heading: Every believer is called to share
cards.scriptureText: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit.
cards.body: The Great Commission was not given only to pastors and missionaries, it was given to every follower of Jesus. You are already positioned in relationships, workplaces, and communities that no one else can reach in quite the same way.
cards.question: Who in your current circle of relationships might be open to hearing about Jesus?

cards.heading: Start with your story
cards.scriptureText: Then Agrippa said to Paul, 'You have permission to speak for yourself.'
cards.body: Paul shared his personal testimony before kings. Your story, how your life was before Christ, how you came to faith, and how your life is different now, is compelling because it is yours. No one can argue with your experience.
cards.question: Can you summarize your faith story in 2–3 minutes? Practice telling it now.

cards.heading: Ask good questions
cards.scriptureText: When a Samaritan woman came to draw water, Jesus said to her, 'Will you give me a drink?'
cards.body: Jesus rarely started with a monologue. He started with a question. Good questions open doors that arguments never can. Ask about what someone believes, what gives their life meaning, or whether they've ever thought about spiritual things.
cards.question: What is one question you could naturally ask a friend this week to open a spiritual conversation?

cards.heading: Trust the Holy Spirit
cards.scriptureText: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes on you; and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.
cards.body: Witnessing is not a performance, it is a partnership. The Holy Spirit convicts, draws, and transforms. Your job is to be faithful and available, not to manufacture results. You plant and water; God gives the growth.
cards.question: How does knowing the Holy Spirit is at work change how you feel about sharing your faith?

cards.heading: Follow through with discipleship
cards.scriptureText: And the things you have heard me say in the presence of many witnesses entrust to reliable people who will also be qualified to teach others.
cards.body: Evangelism that does not lead to discipleship is incomplete. When someone comes to faith, they need relationships, Scripture, and community. The goal is not a decision, it is a disciple. Walk with new believers in their first steps.
cards.question: If someone in your life came to faith today, what would your next step be to help them grow?
